data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root h-n-y, meaning 'to be gracious, kind, or beautiful'. In Islamic tradition, Hannah represents the qualities of grace, beauty, and compassion. The name hannah carries the meaning “Grace, beauty, or compassionate” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian.
